channel.display-name: In The Heat Of The Night

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: The iconic series that turned Duane Dog Chapman into a household name. Follow Dog and his crew as they track down fugitives who have jumped bail. Then get up close and personal as they encourage criminals to turn their lives around and start a new life.

programme.title: Megafault
programme.desc: Facing unemployment and his girlfriend's rejection, writer Eddie Morra is sure that he has no future. That all changes when an old friend gives him a drug that produces enhanced mental acuity. Stoked on the untested chemical, Eddie rises to the top of the financial world and attracts the attention of a tycoon who intends to use him to make a fortune. But terrible side effects and a dwindling supply threaten to collapse Eddie's house of cards.

That all changes when an old friend gives him a drug that produces enhanced mental acuity. Stoked on the untested chemical, Eddie rises to the top of the financial world and attracts the attention of a tycoon who intends to use him to make a fortune. But terrible side effects and a dwindling supply threaten to collapse Eddie's house of cards.

programme.title: Snatch Up [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The movie revolves around Eun-sook, a lovely but promiscuous professor in a University, who has all the male professors wrapped around her finger. When a popular comic book artist Suk-gyu joins the environmental awareness group that she belongs to, he attracts the jealously of Mr. Yoo, a group member who fears that he would steal Eun-sook from him, even though Eun-sook does not return his intense love. What is not known to the rest is that Eun-sook and Suk-gyu attended the same junior high school where they share a secretive tragic history. Back then, Eun-sook was the girlfriend of Suk-gyu's older brother and the three rebellious teenagers indulged in sex promiscuously. Eun-sook worries that her past may be revealed. As Mr. Yoo starts snooping around Eun-sook and Suk-gyu's pasts, will their secret be kept and will they be together again?

programme.title: Three Pests In A Mess
programme.desc: The Three Stooges work at Dimsel’s Drug Store where they befriend Schuyler Davis, the owner of the shop next door, who is attempting to build a time machine. With the boys “help,” the time machine transports the boys, Schuyler and his girlfriend Diane back in time to ancient Greece during the reign of the lecherous King Oedious, a distant ancestor of Dimsel. Odius has a yearning for Diane, and banishes Schuyler and the boys into servitude at sea. After a shipwreck, The Three Stooges and Schuyler escape. In the Gladiator arena, they bill Schuyler as Hercules. The real Hercules gets wind of their game and confronts them, but the Stooges convince Hercules to help them rescue Diane and return the rightful king to the throne.

With the boys “help,” the time machine transports the boys, Schuyler and his girlfriend Diane back in time to ancient Greece during the reign of the lecherous King Oedious, a distant ancestor of Dimsel. Odius has a yearning for Diane, and banishes Schuyler and the boys into servitude at sea. After a shipwreck, The Three Stooges and Schuyler escape. In the Gladiator arena, they bill Schuyler as Hercules. The real Hercules gets wind of their game and confronts them, but the Stooges convince Hercules to help them rescue Diane and return the rightful king to the throne.

Odius has a yearning for Diane, and banishes Schuyler and the boys into servitude at sea. After a shipwreck, The Three Stooges and Schuyler escape. In the Gladiator arena, they bill Schuyler as Hercules. The real Hercules gets wind of their game and confronts them, but the Stooges convince Hercules to help them rescue Diane and return the rightful king to the throne.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The 2025–26 season reaches its epic conclusion as the defending champion Utah Tech Trailblazers face a "mountain to climb" against the undefeated Florida Atlantic Owls. Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: La Carrera De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Sabías que, si atrapas un trol, este puede concederte un deseo? Resulta que Aloysius el trol ha quedado atrapado en una de las pitufitrampas de Gargamel. Pitufo Colérico le libera y, como recompensa, consigue que los demás Pitufos satisfagan todos sus caprichos. Esto acarrea un montón de problemas para los Pitufos, ya que los Pitufitos, en ocasiones, piden cosas que no son buenas para ellos… ni tampoco para los demás.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: From military radar to Navy aircraft, sightings of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena have become more frequent of late and been measured on ever more sophisticated technology. It has lead to unprecedented acceptance of alien contact across the globe, including by the US government. What could these visitors be after? It has lead to unprecedented acceptance of alien contact across the globe, including by the US government. What could these visitors be after? Is it the potential energy stored in the Earth's oceans?

programme.title: Megafault
programme.desc: Facing unemployment and his girlfriend's rejection, writer Eddie Morra is sure that he has no future. That all changes when an old friend gives him a drug that produces enhanced mental acuity. Stoked on the untested chemical, Eddie rises to the top of the financial world and attracts the attention of a tycoon who intends to use him to make a fortune. But terrible side effects and a dwindling supply threaten to collapse Eddie's house of cards.

programme.title: Snatch Up [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The movie revolves around Eun-sook, a lovely but promiscuous professor in a University, who has all the male professors wrapped around her finger. When a popular comic book artist Suk-gyu joins the environmental awareness group that she belongs to, he attracts the jealously of Mr. Yoo, a group member who fears that he would steal Eun-sook from him, even though Eun-sook does not return his intense love. What is not known to the rest is that Eun-sook and Suk-gyu attended the same junior high school where they share a secretive tragic history. Back then, Eun-sook was the girlfriend of Suk-gyu's older brother and the three rebellious teenagers indulged in sex promiscuously. Eun-sook worries that her past may be revealed. As Mr. Yoo starts snooping around Eun-sook and Suk-gyu's pasts, will their secret be kept and will they be together again?

When a popular comic book artist Suk-gyu joins the environmental awareness group that she belongs to, he attracts the jealously of Mr. Yoo, a group member who fears that he would steal Eun-sook from him, even though Eun-sook does not return his intense love. What is not known to the rest is that Eun-sook and Suk-gyu attended the same junior high school where they share a secretive tragic history. Back then, Eun-sook was the girlfriend of Suk-gyu's older brother and the three rebellious teenagers indulged in sex promiscuously. Eun-sook worries that her past may be revealed. As Mr. Yoo starts snooping around Eun-sook and Suk-gyu's pasts, will their secret be kept and will they be together again?

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: De Rubens à Degas, les collections du musée des Beaux-Arts de Pau. Autodidacte devenu chef étoilé, Guy Martin revient sur son parcours gastronomique, dans le cadre du Grand Véfour.
